## Hypothesis

In a bullish ribbon alignment, pullbacks to VWAP provide high-probability longs. The edge exists because in an established uptrend (EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50), VWAP often acts as dynamic support, and a touch of VWAP with a close above it indicates resumption of buying pressure with favorable risk-reward.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50 (bullish ribbon) and price touches VWAP within 0.1% and closes above VWAP, go long at the bar's close.  
Exit shape: Stop below the recent swing low (structure invalidation); target 1.5R or trail using a chandelier exit (ATR multiplier 3.0, trail 15%).  
Regime hint: Works best in trending markets (ADX >20) after 10:00 ET; avoid VIX >25 to prevent false signals in high-volatility regimes.
